image_metrics.threshold_origin: externally selected; never optimized by this metric

localization_metrics.overlap_aggregation: pooled pixel counts; empty union yields null
localization_metrics.threshold_origin: externally selected; not optimized using evaluation masks
localization_metrics.au_pro_semantics: normalized area over pooled normal-pixel FPR; equal weight per connected defect region; sampled thresholds
localization_metrics.au_pro_threshold_sampling: uniform ranks of distinct native scores, plus +inf/-inf endpoints
localization_metrics.au_pro_unavailable_reason: Requires a defect component and at least one normal pixel.

risk_coverage.risk_definition: mean 0/1 classification error at the caller-locked detector threshold
risk_coverage.confidence_semantics: ranking input; not assumed to be a calibrated probability
risk_coverage.integration: right-step risk times each whole-group coverage increment
